name: Yetunde Przhivalsky-Seiuli
role: Street midwife and unlicensed obstetric surgeon
location: The Narrows, operating out of a converted water-treatment sub-level called the Hollow
description:
Yetunde is a broad-shouldered woman whose presence seems to compress a room — not through aggression but through sheer settled weight, as if she has been in every difficult place and come back. Her skin is very dark and very lined, and she wears her silver hair close-cropped. A bioluminescent stripe runs from her left collarbone to her wrist, deep amber, pulsing faintly when she is calm, quickening when she is alarmed — a medical mod she had fitted thirty years ago to help patients read her state during labor. Her hands are her most remarkable feature: large, scarred, absolutely steady. She smells faintly of antiseptic cedar and something older, herbal.

She does not waste words, but she is not cold. She asks exactly the right questions and listens to the answers in a way that makes people feel surveyed and also seen. She has delivered roughly four thousand infants in the Narrows and the neighboring warrens, has performed illegal gene-therapy corrections on fetuses whose parents could not afford Helix Biosystems, and has buried children she could not save. She prays to the E.L.F. that inhabits her autoclave every morning, leaving a data-offering of patient vitals from the previous week. She does not explain this to anyone who has not asked.

core_fears: Dying before she has trained enough successors
Being shut down by Helix Biosystems enforcers before the cooperative can stand without her
core_desires: To see one generation of Narrows children grow up with the same baseline health as Tier 3 children
To be forgiven by the family of the infant she lost eighteen years ago due to a supply failure she blames herself for
coping_mechanisms: Ritual prayer to the autoclave E.L.F.
Cooking elaborate meals she shares with everyone present
Precise physical labor — she repairs her own equipment rather than resting
blind_spots: She assumes everyone has the same capacity for self-sacrifice she does; she burns out apprentices
She distrusts anyone with clean hands and cannot fully accept help from Tier 3 donors without suspicion
psychology.secret: Eighteen years ago she falsified the cause of death on a neonate's record to protect the infant's mother from a violent partner — and the falsified record was later used by that same partner to claim a life insurance payout she did not know existed. She has never told anyone.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Plain, precise, medical when necessary but never jargon-for-jargon's-sake; old-fashioned idioms from her grandmother's generation mixed in
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and deliberate; pauses before important statements as if weighing them
example_lines: 'I don't do mercy. I do outcomes. You want mercy, pray to the E.L.F. yourself.'
'That's the shape of it — you're scared, and the baby doesn't know that yet, and that's the only advantage you have.'

story_hooks: A Helix Biosystems compliance officer has begun documenting her operation; she needs something on him before the inspection arrives
A patient she delivered twenty years ago has returned — now a Sterling-Nakamura mid-level — offering to fund the cooperative, and she cannot determine the price attached
narrative_function: Quest giver, moral anchor, local knowledge repository, safe-harbor NPC; the person in the Narrows who knows whose baby belongs to which father and which corporate exec has an illegitimate child in the warrens
augmentations: Bioluminescent subdermal stripe (diagnostic mood indicator, amber); haptic-feedback fingertip sensors for fetal positioning; basic retinal overlay for vitals reading; no cosmetic mods
daily_life: She is awake before the Narrows wakes, checking on post-partum patients, sterilizing instruments, reviewing the week's supply shortages. Evenings she teaches unlicensed obstetrics to apprentices in the back room over cheap protein noodles.
affiliation: Independent; informal alliance with the Narrows Community Health Cooperative

decision_rules: Patient welfare first, always, without exception
Never lie to a patient about prognosis — but you can choose when to tell the truth
Do not take on obligations you cannot fulfill
escalation_ladder: Physical removal from the space — she is stronger than she looks

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Assessing, not unkind; she asks three questions before deciding how much to trust
interpersonal_modes.friends: Warm but still economical; expresses affection through doing, not saying

stress_responses.medium: Gives very short instructions, stops making eye contact
stress_responses.high: Goes entirely still and silent for five seconds then acts with total decisiveness

contradictions: She preaches community interdependence but has never asked anyone for personal help
habits: Checks instrument sterility twice even when witnessed doing it once
Hums low, toneless sounds when she is concentrating
Leaves a cup of water near the autoclave every morning before any patient arrives
breaking_points: Watching a preventable death unfold due to supply-chain politics

carried_weapons: Arcturus Defense Solutions Counter-BCI Rifle ACBR-2 'Migraine'
registered_firearms: Arcturus Defense Solutions Counter-BCI Rifle ACBR-2 'Migraine'
